title: 2019 AMC 12A Problem 1
statement: The area of a pizza with radius \(4\) inches is \(N\) percent larger than the area of a pizza with radius \(3\) inches. What is the integer closest to \(N?\)

solutions.text:
The areas are proportional to the squares of the radii, so the ratio of the larger area to the smaller is \(\dfrac{16}{9}.\)

The percent increase is \[ \left(\dfrac{16}{9} - 1\right) \times 100 = \dfrac{700}{9} \approx 77.8. \] The closest integer is \(78.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The areas are in the ratio \(4^2 : 3^2\)
